## Layer `BlazorShared`

This directory contains the `BlazorShared` layer. BlazorShared holds the models and contracts shared between the Blazor admin and the API. Its architecture rules:

- `layering/blazor-shared-independent` — The BlazorShared layer must reference only itself (external packages are not constrained by this rule). BlazorShared contains the contracts the admin client and the API share, and both the browser and the server build it, so it references no other project.
- Expand any rule above with `sliderule explain <rule-id>`.
